findings.quoted_text: EKR shall pay to PPI, any Minimum Royalties and Additional Royalties due within forty-five (45) days of the end of each Quarter as the case may be subject to reconciliation at the end of each Calendar Year as set forth in Section 6.9.
EKR may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time upon [**] ([**]) days prior, written notice to PPI.

Any and all liability of [PARTY_D] to EKR howsoever arising in respect of this Agreement, the Transition Services and Inventory Agreement or the Supply Agreement and their performance, in contract tort or otherwise, shall be limited (except for death or personal injury caused by the negligence of [PARTY_D] or its employees while acting in the course of their employment) to [**] US Dollars ($[**]); provided however that such limitation shall not apply to the extent that EKR or any EKR Indemnified Party is required to pay in excess of such amount to a third party in respect of a final judgment or order obtained by the third party or as a result of [PARTY_D]'s breach of Section 7.2.12 of the Supply Agreement.
findings.explanation: Your liability is capped, but third-party claims and judgments are excluded from this cap, exposing you to unlimited financial liability for those claims.
findings.suggested_change: Any and all liability of the Contractor to the Client howsoever arising in respect of this Agreement shall be limited to [**] US Dollars ($[**]), and such cap shall apply to all claims without exception, including third-party claims.

findings.quoted_text: EKR shall pay to [PARTY_D], any Minimum Royalties and Additional Royalties due within forty-five (45) days of the end of each Quarter as the case may be subject to reconciliation at the end of each Calendar Year as set forth in Section 6.9.
findings.explanation: Payment is due within 45 days after the end of each quarter, which delays your receipt of funds beyond standard 30-day terms.
findings.suggested_change: The Client shall pay all royalties and amounts due to the Contractor within thirty (30) days of the end of each quarter.

findings.quoted_text: EKR may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time upon [**] ([**]) days prior, written notice to [PARTY_D].
findings.explanation: Only the client can terminate the contract for convenience without cause, while you do not have the same right.
findings.suggested_change: Either Party may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time upon sixty (60) days prior written notice to the other Party.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello. Thank you for sending over the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to suggest a minor adjustment before we sign: - Regarding the relevant clause, payment is due within 45 days after the end of each quarter, which delays your receipt of funds beyond standard 30-day terms. I propose changing this so that the Client shall pay all royalties and amounts due to the Contractor within thirty (30) days of the end of each quarter. Please let me know if this adjustment is acceptable. Best regards,
